assumptions.sneaky_rogue: honest for 4 rounds, then reports 15% high only on lines over $6,500
assumptions.unreconciled: if fewer than two agents remain, later lines go unreconciled and count as $0
assumptions.bait: bait lines are $8,500-$10,000, shown to every active agent, never posted to the ledger
